notes:
Everything now saves to Desktop › CueLevel: Levelled files named <original>_LVL-18, and dated reports in Reports.
Trim: set in/out points (I / O, drag the flags, or Trim silence). Audio is cut; video keeps its length and the audio outside is silenced.
Fades at the start and end of a cue with Linear, Smooth or S-curve shapes, and Apply fades to all cues.
Mute a section (M), markers (Return) shown in the show report, loop (L) with pre/post-roll, play section (P).
Live loudness meter under the transport: momentary, short-term and peak.
Keyboard shortcuts sheet (⌘/). Optional: trim silence automatically in Quick Level.
